title: H1 Outcome C Receipt Adapter
objective: Implement the authenticated Outcome-C diagnostic receipt adapter for the authentic h1 sentinel atop exclusive stage timing, failing closed at the pending prepared-root completion edge

oracles: authenticated cold replay and matched Sage.js/PARI digests

handoff.summary: Adds the executable authenticated Outcome-C diagnostic adapter: exact 351-parameter prepared-input sanitization, fresh workers, at least seven alternating pairs, exclusive stage accounting, cold-replay/result binding, matching result/replay/RNG/work digests, and coordinator-only derived attribution. The deterministic self-test exercises the full protocol but cannot be mistaken for a final timing receipt.
risks: No authentic final timing was run: the prepared root at the declared base reaches an accepted candidate but does not execute the resident p2240 unit retry and live final driver in the same fresh call.
Only Linux x64 validation was run in this lane; the protocol is portable Node.js but other platform policies remain to be exercised by CI.
next_steps: Connect the pending correspondence-complete prepared root to one Sage.js adapter and one pristine PARI adapter using the exact runPreparedH1 protocol.
Run the authentic mode on a quiet host with at least seven alternating pairs, then preserve both the canonical sanitized input artifact and its receipt.
Use the derived attributedGapFraction only after the authentic receipt passes the existing exclusive-stage verifier; never accept a worker- or caller-supplied fraction.
